info.title: Society App API
info.description:
Backend for a multi-tenant society management platform.

Three clients consume this API: an Expo app for residents and security guards, a society admin console, and a platform console for superadmin and salesperson.

Every response uses the same envelope. Every society-scoped record is constrained to the caller's society; only superadmin and salesperson read across societies.

This document is generated from the route table — edit the routes, not this file.

bearerAuth.description: Access tokens last 8h for superadmin and salesperson, 30d for residents.

nextCursor.description: Cursor mode only. Pass as `?cursor=` for the next page.

truncated.description: The response exceeded the hard cap and was trimmed. Page through the full set.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted, or not yet approved.

NotFound.description: No such record. Also returned when a record belongs to another society.

get.description: Paginated. Responses carry a `meta` object.
